title: Blood Request and Transfusion Procedure
content:
SOP: Blood Request and Transfusion Procedure (SOP-BLD-001)
DEPARTMENT: Blood Bank
VERSION: 3.2
ROLES: doctor, nurse, lab_tech
PURPOSE: Compatible blood component testing and dual-nurse verification.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Blood Request and Transfusion Procedure in full compliance with Blood Bank hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Blood Request and Transfusion Procedure in full compliance with Blood Bank hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Blood Request and Transfusion Procedure in full compliance with Blood Bank hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Blood Request and Transfusion Procedure in full compliance with Blood Bank hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Blood Request and Transfusion Procedure in full compliance with Blood Bank hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Blood Request and Transfusion Procedure in full compliance with Blood Bank hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 7: Execute phase 7 of Blood Request and Transfusion Procedure in full compliance with Blood Bank hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Blood Bank.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-BLD-001 Blood Request and Transfusion Procedure v3.2, Section 4
